transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm... I'm here because of work, mostly. I just... I keep going back over the same spreadsheets. And the calculations. Again and again. Sometimes I stay for hours after everyone else leaves. Even when I already checked them. It's just... if I don't do it one more time, I get this feeling that something bad will happen. And it'll be my fault.
Can you tell me more about those feelings that make you check the spreadsheets again? Are they intrusive thoughts or a sense that something bad will happen if you don’t do it just right?

It's... I guess it's like a thought that just won't leave me alone. Even when I know the numbers match up perfectly, it just... jumps in my head. Like I missed some hidden mistake in the payroll or the taxes. And if I did, then... someone's check won't go through, or the firm will get in trouble. I try to push the thought away, but it just comes right back. It's like I can't even trust my own eyes anymore.
Do you feel anxious or upset when you try to stop yourself from checking the spreadsheets again?
Yeah... I guess so. I just... I get really tense, I guess. It's just easier to keep checking than to try and stop.
Do these checking behaviors take up a lot of your time, or cause you a lot of stress?

Yeah... it takes up a lot of time. I mean... I actually missed a filing deadline recently because of it. They called me into a formal meeting at work. And... I guess I've stopped going to my choir rehearsals, too. And the youth center stuff I used to do. I just... I can't ever get out of the office on time to make it anymore.
Do these intrusive thoughts ever happen outside of work, like at home or during other activities, or are they mostly about things related to your job?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... it's mostly just the job. I don't really notice it happening with other things. Just... the accounts and stuff at work.
Have you ever felt the need to double-check or repeat actions outside of work, like making sure the stove is off or the door is locked, even when you know you already did?
No... not really. I mean, I lock my door when I leave, but... I don't go back and check it. It's just the work stuff.
Have you noticed these thoughts or checking behaviors affecting your life outside of work, like your relationships, sleep, or ability to relax at home?

Um... I don't know. Not really. I mean... I just go home and sleep. I guess I don't have much time for anything else anyway, since I'm at the office so late. But... no, the thoughts don't really happen at home.
When those intrusive thoughts about mistakes at work pop into your head, do you try to ignore them or push them away, and does that cause you a lot of distress?

Um... yeah, I try to ignore them. But... it doesn't really work. Even when I know the numbers match up, I just get this... this thought that I missed some hidden mistake in the payroll or the taxes. Like... like someone's check won't go through, or the firm will get in trouble. I try to push it out of my head, but... it just keeps coming back. It's like I can't even trust my own eyes. It's... yeah, it's pretty stressful.

When you have those intrusive thoughts about mistakes at work, do you feel driven to perform certain actions or rituals—like rechecking numbers in a specific way—until the anxiety decreases or the thought goes away?

Um... yeah. I guess so. I just... I have to go back over the spreadsheets. And the calculations. I just do them again and again. Sometimes I stay at work for hours after everyone else leaves. I just... I know I already checked them, but I have to do it one more time. If I don't... I just feel like something bad is going to happen, and it'll be my fault.

When you recheck the spreadsheets, does it feel like you're trying to stop a specific bad event—like someone's paycheck bouncing or the company getting in trouble—or is it more about trying to feel more certain or in control of your work?
Um... I don't know. Both, I guess. I just... I don't want anything bad to happen. So I just check it to be sure.
Have you ever had unwanted or intrusive thoughts, or felt the need to do something over and over again outside of work, even if it's not related to your job?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. It's... it's mostly just the work stuff. I haven't really noticed doing anything like that at home.
Do these thoughts and the need to check the spreadsheets over and over make it hard for you to function normally at work, like getting tasks done on time or focusing on other responsibilities?

Yeah... it does. I, um... I actually missed a filing deadline recently. My boss called me into a formal meeting about it. And... I don't really go to choir practice anymore. Or volunteer at the youth center. I just... I can never seem to leave the office on time to make it to those things.
